title: finding(plugin-charts): a `horizontal-bar` chart mis-lays its axis titles — the `xAxis.title` of its category axis is never drawn, and the `yAxis` title is drawn rotated at the left beside the category ticks instead of under the value axis it names
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites (class a). A declared and documented key ("Axis title…") is not honoured on one chart family, and the other key's title is drawn beside the wrong axis. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`). The sources are the objectui#10587 dev report (PR objectui#10647, finding 1, "noted, not filed") and the contract review of that PR at `904b074`, which measured it and called a separate card owed: the same class as objectui#10587, with a different key and a different defect. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Sites (the reviewer's reading at PR objectui#10647's head `904b074`; ⛔ not re-read by the seat)

- `packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx`, the `horizontal-bar` branch:
  - the category axis is a `type="category"` YAxis (~:2511) that carries no `label`, so `xAxis.title` is never drawn;
  - the number XAxis (~:2507) takes `yAxisSpecProps(primaryY)`, whose title layout is always `Y_AXIS_TITLE_LAYOUT` (~:1661), which is rotated and meant for a vertical axis.
- The branch already routes `xAxis.format` to the category YAxis's `tickFormatter` (~:2520) and the spec `yAxis` to the number XAxis, so "the `xAxis` object follows the categories" is the reading the existing routing implies (PR objectui#10647 places `xAxis.position` on that reading).

## Measurement (the PR objectui#10647 reviewer's probe; ⛔ not re-run by the seat)

`horizontal-bar` with `xAxis: { field: 'month', title: 'Month' }` and `yAxis: [{ field: 'revenue', title: 'Revenue' }]` renders ONE label, "Revenue", with `rotate(-90, 70, 330)`. The `bar` control renders "Month" at the bottom (y=349) and "Revenue" rotated at x=10.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

On `horizontal-bar`, draw `xAxis.title` on the category axis, laid out for a vertical axis, and the `yAxis` title under the number axis, laid out for a horizontal one. Pin both titles against the `bar` control. The docs `title` row may need a sentence on which axis each title names on `horizontal-bar`.

## Dedupe

REST read of every objectui issue and PR updated since 2026-09-25T00:00Z (367 items), with titles matched against `yAxis|y-axis|y axis|horizontal-bar|axis title|right-hand|position`: no hit about `horizontal-bar` titles. The regex walk over the 1000 most recently updated items, `horizontal-bar.*title`, gives 0 hits about this defect.

Dedupe words: `horizontal-bar axis title missing` · `hbar xAxis title not drawn` · `Y_AXIS_TITLE_LAYOUT horizontal-bar` · `horizontal-bar yAxis title rotated`
